reasoning: A premium, luxurious educational kids app (alfakids / DIVERSÃO E APRENDIZADO). Target audience is parents willing to pay for premium educational content for 3-5yo. We use a dark background (#0D0D0D) combined with gold (#BF9663) and orange (#D97016), incorporating neon/fluorescent cyan and purple gradients for child-friendly interactive elements while maintaining a high-end luxury aesthetic.

rules.titles: Use gold or bright white for titles, with optional subtle text-shadow for a glowing effect.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding. p-6 to p-8 inside cards, gap-8 in bento grids.
layout_and_spacing.container_corners: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for a safe, kid-friendly but premium look.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento Grid style for the 4 main tabs on desktop. Mobile will stack cards elegantly. Always maintain equal heights for cards using h-full.

cards.style: Glassmorphism with a 1px border. Dark mode: border-white/10, Light mode: border-black/10.
cards.effects: Glowing hover states. Cards should have a subtle backdrop-blur-xl.

buttons.premium_plan: Animated button with a fluorescent border passing side to side. Achieved via mask-image and a rotating conic-gradient in the background.
buttons.standard: Rounded-full, luxurious gold (#BF9663) background with black text, or dark background with glowing gold borders.

animations.golden_shimmer: An animated linear-gradient overlay sliding from left to right, creating a shimmer effect over text or cards.
animations.glow_pulse: Periodic scaling and opacity changes of a blurred radial gradient behind key elements.
animations.fade_in_up: Initial load staggered fade-in and slide-up for all content blocks (using framer-motion).
animations.floating: Slow continuous Y-axis translation for decorative icons or photos.
animations.fireworks: For the congratulations screen. A specialized component using Canvas or a library like 'canvas-confetti' configured for star shapes and bright neon colors.

navigation.header: Sticky glassmorphism header containing the 'alfakids' logo (animated ABC letters on purple background) and a Dark Mode toggle in the top right.
navigation.bottom_tab: For mobile view, a floating glass bottom tab bar with 4 icons. For desktop, a sidebar or top navigation.

pages_and_features.1_alfabetizacao: Literacy tab. 30-day phonics method. Show a progress roadmap with locked/unlocked nodes. Unlocked nodes glow with cyan/purple.
pages_and_features.2_interativo_musical: Musical instruments + YouTube videos. Use 3D-like buttons for instruments. Include the fireworks animation at the end of a song.
pages_and_features.3_aprender_ingles: Learn English. Audio + Image cards. Flashcard UI with flip animations.
pages_and_features.4_recursos: Pedagogical PDF resources. List view with luxurious download buttons and golden document icons.
pages_and_features.login_system: Sleek, centered login card with glowing borders.
pages_and_features.pwa_install: A prominent but elegant 'Install App' banner or button with a subtle pulse animation.

images.description: Golden metallic lines against a black background for the premium feel
A wooden block spelling magic on top of a book for the English tab

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Apply Montserrat font globally. Add `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` to index.html and update tailwind font family rules.
Use framer-motion extensively for the 'fade-in-up', 'floating', and 'golden shimmer' effects.

To achieve the 'fluorescent border passing side to side' on the premium button, create a wrapper div with a rotating conic-gradient (cyan/purple) and padding of 2px, then an inner div with the dark background. Use framer-motion to spin the gradient.
Implement the 'alfakids' logo as requested: 'alfakids aprender a ler' text accompanied by animated ABC letters set against a purple background.
For the congratulations screen, use the 'canvas-confetti' package, configured to burst bright cyan, purple, and gold colors to mimic fireworks.
The 4 main sections should be built as independent views navigated via a sleek floating tab bar on mobile, and a sticky header nav on desktop.
Ensure dark mode toggle is clearly visible in the top corner and fully functional.
Build the progress map in the Alfabetização tab using connected nodes (circles), where locked nodes are gray/faded and unlocked ones glow intensely.
Install the following dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, canvas-confetti, lucide-react.
